senses.gloss: to qualify, define; to surname, to nickname; to modify an expression, circumscribe; to compare.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b:13">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>המְכַנֶּה שם רע וכ׳</he> he who calls his neighbor by a nickname.
<cite ref="Shevuot 36a:21">Shebu. 36ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="K00836"><he>כַּנֵּה</he></cite> circumscribe (use the third person as euphemism).
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 84">Sifré Num. 84</cite>, a. fr. <he>כי׳ הכתוב</he> the Bible modifies the expression (to avoid anthropomorphism, e.g.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:9">Meg. IV, 9</cite> <he>המבנה בעריות</he> he who modifies (symbolizes) in translating the laws of incest (e.g.
<cite ref="Leviticus 18:7">Lev. XVIII, 7</cite>, ‘uncover not thy parents’ weakness or disgrace’).

Yalk. Num. 771, v. פּוֹלְיָיטוֹן; a. fr. Part. pass. מְכוּנֶּה. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 17 (ref. to באדם, Ps. LXVIII, 19) מכ׳ משה באדם (not לאדם) the name of Moses is here disguised by the substitute Adam.—[Yalk. Ps. 832 מכונה, v. כָּנַן.]

senses.gloss: <cite ref="K00835"><he>כִּנָּה</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00565"><he>כִּינָּה</he></cite> (b. h., v. <cite ref="K00826"><he>כֵּן</he> I</cite>)
